verdict.rationale: Notion's flexible databases and boards can be configured into kanban-style sprint/task trackers (comm-18 confirms boards/task lists exist), and teams have used it in place of Jira/Asana (comm-12). However, there's no evidence of native agile-specific features like sprints, backlog velocity, or burndown charts, and community feedback notes it hits limits as a dedicated project/issue tracker (comm-6).
